description: WOF records whose representative point lies over 1 km outside the polygon of their wof:parent_id and inside another polygon of the parent's placetype. The corpus keeps each record's name and gives it no parent and no ancestors. distance_m is the distance from the point to the parent polygon; inside_id is the polygon that holds the point.
checked: WOF admin GeoJSON checkouts of 2026-10-26, point in polygon against each parent's geometry
